announcements.headline: Shareholder Loan
announcements.insight: Pennant International Group secured a shareholder loan. This follows recent Auxilium commercial milestones including a multiyear contract and US Defence sales.

announcements.headline: Siemens-driven Auxilium sales into US Defence
announcements.insight: Auxilium sales into US Defence follow the June partnership award. This expands commercial reach for the service contract.

announcements.headline: First Auxilium – GenS Sale via Siemens Partnership
announcements.insight: Following the June contract award, this sale via a Siemens partnership marks a significant commercial milestone for Auxilium services.

announcements.headline: Multiyear Auxilium Services Contract Award
announcements.insight: Pennant International Group secured a multiyear Auxilium Services Contract Award. This follows the launch of Auxilium Phase 3 in June 2026, indicating progression of that initiative.

announcements.headline: Launch of Auxilium Phase 3
announcements.insight: Pennant International Group has launched Auxilium Phase 3. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent updates regarding the progress and outcomes of this phase.
